items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And then that's the choir that played with Kenny Spencer

ctx.x: And then that's the choir that played with Kenny Spencer and we played the "Ballad of America", you know, that Paul Robeson used to do. Kenneth Spencer did it and then we had the evening in Carnegie Hall. And we had quite a job. That's the one when I walked into Rae. And her mother brought Rae to me at that time, you see.
